description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'GatewayPlaceholderReferenceNotSupportedException' indicating that a request contains an unsupported entity reference placeholder within the 'org.eclipse.ditto' project. The class includes static methods for creating instances from JSON and based on unsupported entity types, along with a builder class for fluent creation.

classes.name: GatewayPlaceholderReferenceNotSupportedException
classes.description: Custom runtime exception indicating an unsupported placeholder reference in a request.

classes.name: GatewayPlaceholderReferenceNotSupportedException.Builder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing 'GatewayPlaceholderReferenceNotSupportedException' instances with a fluent API.

methods.name: fromUnsupportedEntityType
methods.description: Creates a builder for the exception, initialized with a message and description based on the unsupported entity type and supported types.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an exception instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers.
